operations.title: Benincasa closes the source-side factor-four composition
operations.body: Entry 1139 is complete (epistemic event ev-000000000850-4e96d84d-6cde-4989-9d88-c35124a92526). The labelled maps compose strictly: S=-2 I6 from oriented sheet differences to primitive odd coinvariants, followed by Entry 356's F, gives C=-2F. Its Smith invariants are (2,2,2), and on cyclic invariant generators C sends x to -4y. This validates the source-side two-by-two provenance of the denominator four. It still does not prove physical e6 Betti Z/4 torsion; the next gate is the integral Betti comparison square.
